{{Quote|If my ''rancor'' were here, ''he'd'' protect us!|Kralla|<ref name="Downhill">{{TCWComicCite|6.43|Downhill}}</ref>}}
'''Kralla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Felucian/Legends|Felucian]] that lived on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She had a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] she loved. One day, soldiers of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] attacked and destroyed her village. She was one of the few survivors, and to protect her rancor, told him to leave.

Later, she met the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during a [[Mission to Felucia (Skywalker and Kenobi)|mission]] on Felucia.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kralla is first identified in ''[[Downhill]]'', in ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.43|Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic UK 6.43]]''. In this comic, she refers to her rancor and the destruction of her village. This corresponds to the young Felucian that can be seen in ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]'', in the ''Rancor Rampage'' activity. In addition, both have exactly the same clothing, confirming that Kralla is the same person.
